basic_details.short_information: Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (GADVASU), Ludhiana, has invited online applications from eligible candidates only for 45 Group C posts - Steno Typist, Clerk, and Storekeeper - under Advertisement No. 03/2026. Eligible candidates can apply online at www.gadvasu.in from 16 September 2026 to 8 October 2026 (4:00 PM).

application_fee.details: Application fee is not mentioned in the documents provided.

age_limit.details: Age limit is not specified in the documents provided for any of the three posts.

qualification.details: In addition to the degree, all three posts require the following common conditions: | Computer proficiency: At least a 120-hour course with "hands-on experience" in the use of a personal computer, or "Information Technology in Office Productivity Application," or "Desktop Publishing Applications," from a Government-recognised institution or a reputed ISO 9001-certified institution - OR a passed course in Computer Information Technology equivalent to the "O" level certificate of the Department of Electronics Accreditation of Computer Courses (DOEACC), Government of India. Punjabi language: Must have passed the Matriculation examination in Punjabi Language from the Punjab School Education Board, or any other recognised Board (as first, second, or additional language), or an equivalent examination in Punjabi as may be specified by GADVASU from time to time, on or before the last date of submission of application. | The Storekeeper post carries the following duties, as specified in the notification: | Maintaining stock registers and ensuring timely entry of stock receipts and issues. Maintaining inventory registers and records of consumable and non-consumable articles. Keeping stock registers updated at all times in accordance with stock transactions and store requirements. Assessing and processing requirements of store articles from time to time. Preparing unserviceable items for auction/disposal as per prescribed procedure. Ensuring proper maintenance and custody of store records and inventories. Any other duty assigned from time to time.

salary_details.details: Pay scale/salary is not specified in the documents provided for Storekeeper, Clerk, or Steno-Typist posts.

content_sections.heading: GADVASU Group C Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only, along with the prescribed fee, by the stipulated date. The hard-copy forwarding requirement applies only to in-service candidates whose applications must be routed through proper channel. Candidates must ensure they fulfil the prescribed minimum eligibility criteria - including educational qualifications, age, category, and other applicable conditions - as on the last date to apply online, since eligibility will be verified against attached/uploaded documents; candidates not fulfilling the prescribed eligibility criteria will be liable to outright rejection of their application and will not be allowed to appear in any stage of the selection process, including written/proficiency tests.

Punjabi language: Must have passed the Matriculation examination in Punjabi Language from the Punjab School Education Board, or any other recognised Board (as first, second, or additional language), or an equivalent examination in Punjabi as may be specified by GADVASU from time to time, on or before the last date of submission of application. The Storekeeper post carries the following duties, as specified in the notification: Maintaining stock registers and ensuring timely entry of stock receipts and issues. Maintaining inventory registers and records of consumable and non-consumable articles. Keeping stock registers updated at all times in accordance with stock transactions and store requirements. Assessing and processing requirements of store articles from time to time. Preparing unserviceable items for auction/disposal as per prescribed procedure. Ensuring proper maintenance and custody of store records and inventories. Any other duty assigned from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What is GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment process by Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (GADVASU) for three Group C posts - Storekeeper, Clerk, and Steno-Typist - each with a distinct multi-stage selection procedure after a common qualifying Punjabi Language Test.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for GADVASU Group C posts?
faq.answer: Storekeeper requires a Bachelor's degree with Economics/B.Com/BBA; Clerk and Steno-Typist require any Bachelor's degree. All three additionally require a certified 120-hour computer course (or equivalent DOEACC "O" level certificate) and a pass in Matriculation-level Punjabi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the GADVASU Group C selection process?
faq.answer: All three posts start with a qualifying Punjabi Language Test, followed by a Main Examination. Storekeeper candidates then undergo document verification directly; Clerk candidates must additionally clear a qualifying Typing Proficiency Test; and Steno-Typist candidates must clear a Shorthand Proficiency Test whose marks count towards the final merit — see the Selection Process section above for full details.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are announced for GADVASU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 45 vacancies have been announced – 15 Steno Typist, 20 Clerk, and 10 Storekeeper.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for GADVASU Non-Teaching posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Punjabi Language Test (Qualifying), Main Examination, and Skill/Proficiency Test (Typing for Clerk, Shorthand for Steno Typist).

faq.question: Q6. Which posts are available under GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Steno Typist, Clerk, and Storekeeper under Advertisement No. 03/2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 8 October 2026 up to 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. Is Punjabi language qualification required for GADVASU Group C Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi Language from a recognised board or possess an equivalent Punjabi qualification as specified by GADVASU.
